trees.title: From Adam to Christ — the Covenant Line
trees.note: The messianic line runs from the first man through the patriarchs and the house of David to its fulfilment in Jesus Christ.

edges.gap: many generations, through Mary and Joseph

trees.title: The Family of Lehi
trees.note: Lehi and Sariah's sons led the peoples of the Book of Mormon; Jacob's line kept the small plates down to Omni. Ishmael, whose family joined Lehi's in the wilderness, is not shown here as a root, but his daughters married Lehi's sons.

trees.title: The Prophet-Judges: Alma to Nephi the Disciple
trees.note: A single line of prophet-leaders descends from Alma the Elder through Helaman's sons to Nephi the Disciple, who saw the resurrected Christ.

trees.title: The Royal Line of Mosiah
trees.note: Kings Mosiah and Benjamin ruled the Nephites until Mosiah₂ dissolved the monarchy; his sons became missionaries to the Lamanites.

trees.title: Mormon and Moroni
trees.note: The final custodians of the Nephite record, father and son, who abridged and sealed up the plates.

trees.title: The Jaredite Kings
trees.note: The Brother of Jared led his people from the Tower of Babel together with his brother Jared (not shown as a separate node here); many generations of kings followed until the kingdom's destruction under Coriantumr.

edges.gap: many generations of kings, the line of kings that ended with Coriantumr

trees.title: The Holy Family
trees.note: Joseph and Mary raised Jesus Christ, the Son of God, in Nazareth.

trees.title: Elisabeth and John the Baptist
trees.note: Elisabeth, a kinswoman of Mary, was the mother of John the Baptist, the forerunner of Jesus Christ.

trees.title: The Family of Joseph Smith
trees.note: Joseph Smith Sr.'s sons Joseph and Hyrum led the Restoration together; Hyrum's son Joseph F. Smith later became a Church president.
